from AlgorithmImports import *

class ParallelTwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_bars = RollingWindow[TradeBar](3)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        # Keep market-state calculations current for every available bar.
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close))

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_bars.Add(aapl_bar)
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker is missing today.
        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self.spy_closes.IsReady:
            current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
            previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
            yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
            today_close = self.spy_closes[0]

            if yesterday_close >= previous_sma and today_close < current_sma:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and self.spy_closes.IsReady:
            current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
            previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
            yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
            today_close = self.spy_closes[0]

            if yesterday_close <= previous_sma and today_close > current_sma:
                price = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
                shares = int((float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40) // price)

                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_bars.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            red_for_three_days = all(
                self.aapl_bars[i].Close < self.aapl_bars[i].Open
                for i in range(3)
            )

            if red_for_three_days:
                price = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
                cash = float(self.Portfolio.CashBook["USD"].Amount)

                if cash >= 20000:
                    shares = int(20000 // price)

                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = shares

                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.previous_spy_close = None

        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_sma.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        spy_sma_value = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

                    self.previous_spy_sma is not None and

                    spy_close < spy_sma_value):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0:
            if aapl_rsi_value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
            if (self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma and
                    spy_close > spy_sma_value):
                shares = int(math.floor(
                    0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
                ))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0:
